name: GlzNavigationRail
semanticRole: Provide stable primary navigation in a compact vertical rail, normally retaining four to seven core destinations while preserving destination order and reachability.

material.rule: A persistent rail is usually solid or Thin Glaze and approximately 64–72px wide. Core destinations remain stable; contextual tools must not displace or reorder primary navigation.

input.keyboard: Arrow or sequential focus navigation follows the declared rail pattern; Enter or Space activates the focused destination; shortcuts never bypass visible focus requirements.
input.focus: Focused destination remains distinct from selected or current destination.
input.hover: Hover may reveal labels or tooltips for compact items without making essential destination names pointer-only.
input.press: Press feedback begins immediately and does not shift neighboring destinations.
input.selection: Current destination uses filled or active icon plus accent tint and/or label emphasis, with at least two cues.

accessibility.role: Use navigation landmark semantics containing native links/buttons or the platform-equivalent navigation pattern.
accessibility.name: The rail has a stable programmatic label and icon-only destinations expose complete accessible names.
accessibility.state: Current/selected, disabled, loading, and error state are exposed where applicable.
accessibility.value: Navigation destinations expose current-page/current-location semantics rather than synthetic values.
accessibility.keyboard: All destinations, profile/system actions, and any compact label discovery are keyboard accessible.
accessibility.focus: Focus is visible independently from current destination state.
accessibility.errorAssociation: Navigation load or destination errors are associated with the affected destination or status region.
accessibility.reducedMotion: Selection and compact/labeled transitions use direct state changes or short crossfades.
accessibility.reducedTransparency: Thin/Regular Glaze resolves to opaque navigation material.
accessibility.increasedContrast: Strengthen destination focus and current-state indicator.
accessibility.forcedColors: Use platform navigation/focus colors and explicit current markers.
accessibility.largeText: Labels adapt without shrinking core targets or obscuring current destination.

fallbacks.reducedMotion: Use direct selection and label transitions.
fallbacks.forcedColors: Use system colors and explicit current state.
fallbacks.performance: Remove blur and decorative shadow before altering destination order or targets.

content.overflow: Primary destinations remain within the rail; secondary/context actions move to governed zones rather than forcing width or overlap.
content.localization: Accessible names and optional labels tolerate expansion without changing destination order.
content.rtl: Rail placement and logical navigation affordances mirror where product/platform conventions require it; non-directional symbols retain orientation.

criteria: Rail remains approximately 64–72px wide in its standard persistent form.
Primary destinations remain stable when contextual tools appear.
Current destination uses multiple cues and remains clear in forced colors.
Compact visual targets retain 48px effective floors and 56px with Touch Assistance.
